comments.body:
Hey so you're passing a whole Cosmos2_5_PredictBasePipeline as `safety_checker`, but it expects a `CosmosSafetyChecker` and that's why `check_text_safety` is missing (note the "Expected types for safety_checker… got …Pipeline" warning in your log). Either drop the `safety_checker=` arg so it builds one automatically, or pass `CosmosSafetyChecker(...)` from `cosmos_guardrail` (which you've already imported). 

For fully offline use you'll probably want the guardrail weights cached locally.
